cover.title: Route advance: Willard to The Anthem to Fiola Mare and back
cover.intro: Made-up trip built to test the route advance skill. Places are real and public; principal, team and event are made up. Map data read Nov 9 and 10, 2026.
facts: Friday, Nov 20, 2026, evening. All times Eastern.
Principal plus 1 agent driving, one SUV. Site advance person meets us at The Anthem.

Start/end: InterContinental The Willard, 1401 Pennsylvania Ave NW
1. The Anthem, 901 Wharf St SW: private reception 6:00 to 8:00 PM (made up)
2. Fiola Mare, 3050 K St NW (Washington Harbour): dinner about 8:15 to 10:15 PM

overall.why: go as planned, with two notes: concert crowd at The Anthem pick-up, and one way in and out at Washington Harbour.

timeline.text: 9 to 11 min, 13 with buffer. 15th St, Penn Ave, 9th St tunnel.

The Anthem
Reception 6:00 to 8:00. Concert crowd at pick-up.
12 to 13 min, 15 with buffer. Independence Ave, Potomac Fwy, K St.

Fiola Mare
Dinner. Closes 10:30 PM. One way in and out.
11 to 12 min, 15 with buffer. K St, 17th St, H St, 14th St.

Willard: arrive
Agent walks the principal to the room.

cover.drive_times_note: Drive times: Mapbox and TomTom for those departure times, read Nov 9. The higher one sets the buffer.

watch_outs.text: Concert at The Anthem, show 8:00 PM (JamBase and Songkick, read Nov 10). Crowd builds from about 7 PM and meets our 8:00 PM pick-up. Other venues: see the events check on page 3.
Fiola Mare closes 10:30 PM on Fridays (TomTom listing). Our 10:15 PM departure is close to closing.
One way in and out at Washington Harbour. Both routes use K St under the Whitehurst Fwy.
White House security zone next to the Willard (15th St, 17th and H St). Streets can close with little notice.

recon.intro: Best on a Friday evening between 5:30 and 10:30 PM, the same as the move. Allow about 1.5 hours to drive all three legs, both routes, and the hospital runs. Short on time? Do the 15-minute minimum: drive the primary into each stop, look at the drop-off, pick-up and rally point, and find the nearest way out. Log what you drive on the recon log form.

confidence: Verified (Nov 9 and 10): addresses and stopping points (Mapbox, TomTom); routes, times and hospital turns (Mapbox, TomTom); closures (TomTom); trauma levels (hospital sites); Fiola Mare hours (TomTom); events (venue sites and listings); sunset (calculated).

Not checked: doors, garage entrances, curb rules, ER door and rally point lobby hours (recon); weather (out of range).
